MR MATTHEW LAM KIN HONG BBS MH JP: Mr J C H Ho (Stipendiary Steward)
CHEERFUL WONGCHOY: Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Sent for sampling post-race.
THE LION KING: A Atzeni stated that after obtaining a handy position with cover his mount failed to respond to his riding in the Home Straight but could offer no excuse for the disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FLASH STAR: Near the 1400 Metres was steadied to avoid KASA PAPA.  L Hewitson stated that from the outside barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  Trainer C S Shum confirmed the instructions and advised that with the horse stepping up from 1200 Metres to 1650 Metres he issued those instructions to allow it to run out the distance of tonight’s race.
THE ALL ROUNDER: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners and then in the early stages raced keenly.  Shifted in leaving the 1500 Metres and was bumped.  C Y Ho stated that after settling back in the field his mount found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight due to the early and middle stages of the event being run outside of standard time.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
MADE FOR LIFE: Jumped only fairly and then was crowded between SETANTA and WINNING DIAMOND.  Leaving the 1500 Metres was bumped by THE ALL ROUNDER which shifted in.  K C Leung stated that his mount settled further back in the field than intended after being crowded at the start.  He added in the Home Straight MADE FOR LIFE finished the race off only fairly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, MADE FOR LIFE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
SETANTA: Shifted out at the start and was bumped.
KASA PAPA: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
ORIENTAL SURPRISE: Passing the 50 Metres lay in towards WINDICATOR FAMILY which shifted out slightly and as a result was eased to avoid WINDICATOR FAMILY.
WINNING DIAMOND: On jumping became unbalanced when bumped by CHEERFUL WONGCHOY.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SHAMZ: On jumping was crowded between VERMILION TEMPEST and DRAGON ON SNOW.  Approaching the 500 Metres was hampered when bumped by CASA ROCHESTER which shifted out to obtain a trailing position behind VERMILION TEMPEST.  Bumped near the 300 Metres.
DRAGON ON SNOW: Shifted in at the start and became unbalanced when it made contact with SHAMZ.  Trainer D Eustace confirmed the instructions and stated with blinkers being applied for the first occasion he expected the horse to hold a more forward position.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of DRAGON ON SNOW, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, DRAGON ON SNOW will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
CASA ROCHESTER: From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Approaching the 500 Metres shifted out and made contact with SHAMZ.  Held up for some distance on the Home Turn.  Near the 300 Metres shifted out to obtain clear running and made contact with SHAMZ.
IVY LEAGUE: Approaching the 400 Metres improved to the inside of MASSIVE REWARD when there was not sufficient room to do so, resulting in IVY LEAGUE then being crowded to the inside of MASSIVE REWARD and also causing LUCKY TOGETHER to be badly crowded and becoming unbalanced.  R Kingscote was reprimanded and advised he must ensure there is sufficient room for him to improve into in similar circumstances.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
VERMILION TEMPEST: Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Leaving the 700 Metres was steadied to avoid GAZELEY.
LUCKY TOGETHER: Leaving the 1400 Metres was steadied to avoid AKERMANIS GOLD when taken in by GAZELEY (M Chadwick) which shifted in.  M Chadwick was reprimanded and advised he must ensure he leaves comfortable racing room for runners to his inside.  Approaching the 400 Metres became badly unbalanced when crowded by IVY LEAGUE.  Approaching the 100 Metres was shifted to the inside of SURE JOYFUL to continue into clear running.
GAZELEY: Near the 700 Metres, when the pace steadied, shifted out to avoid IVY LEAGUE.  Sent for sampling post-race.
MASSIVE REWARD: Shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped by SURE JOYFUL.  Near the 300 Metres, when commencing to give ground, was steadied to avoid DRAGON ON SNOW which shifted out under pressure.  The performance of MASSIVE REWARD, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MASSIVE REWARD will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
SURE JOYFUL: Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.
SHOOTING TO TOP: Shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped by CALIFORNIA MOXIE.  Sent for sampling post-race.
CALIFORNIA MOXIE: Crowded shortly after the start by KYOTO SPRING which shifted in. When questioned B Avdulla stated that near the 650 Metres when KYOTO SPRING improved past his mount CALIFORNIA MOXIE then shifted out abruptly and as a result he was obliged to correct his mount to prevent it from shifting further ground.
RAINBOW SEVEN: Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 650 Metres was checked to avoid CALIFORNIA MOXIE which shifted out abruptly despite the efforts of its rider.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
THE AZURE: Held up making the Home Turn.
KYOTO SPRING: Shifted in shortly after the start and made contact with CALIFORNIA MOXIE.  After travelling a short distance was crowded between RED BRICK WARRIOR which shifted in slightly and CALIFORNIA MOXIE which was taken out slightly by SHOOTING TO TOP.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FAMILY KNIGHT: Noted to have sustained abrasions on both knees on arrival at Happy Valley, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Near the 300 Metres was eased to avoid SHOOTING TO TOP which shifted out and away from RED BRICK WARRIOR.  M L Yeung reported that his mount jumped well and settled further forward than what he had anticipated.  He added in the Home Straight he was satisfied with his horse’s finishing effort.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
RED BRICK WARRIOR: Jumped awkwardly.  Passing the winning post, RED BRICK WARRIOR, which was laying out, was steadied to avoid SHOOTING TO TOP (Z Purton) which shifted in.  Z Purton was advised to exercise more care.
PRESTIGE RICKY: At declaration time A Atzeni was declared as the rider of both RED BRICK WARRIOR and PRESTIGE RICKY.  It was established that A Atzeni had a firm commitment to ride RED BRICK WARRIOR.  As such, the Stewards permitted K Teetan to be substituted as the rider of PRESTIGE RICKY.  For this declaration error, Trainer P F Yiu was fined $2,000.  Raced keenly in the early stages.  Sent for sampling post-race. K Teetan was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides passing the 200 Metres. K Teetan was warned in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion over the concluding stages.
DRAGON FOUR SEAS: Crowded on jumping between FORERUNNER and CASA BUDDY.  Near the 1100 Metres was steadied when crowded by SAME TO YOU which shifted out.  In this incident DRAGON FOUR SEAS shifted out, made contact with CASA BUDDY and became unbalanced.
FORERUNNER: On jumping shifted out and made contact with DRAGON FOUR SEAS.  FORERUNNER then raced tight between DRAGON FOUR SEAS and SAME TO YOU which shifted out.  Making the Home Turn was unable to improve to the outside of SAME TO YOU when that runner shifted out.  As a result FORERUNNER was shifted to the inside of SAME TO YOU to continue into clear running.
ELEGANT LIFE: Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
LEADING DRAGON: Noted to have sustained a minor laceration to the right hock whilst being transported to the course, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Bumped approaching the winning post.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
LOOKING BRIGHT: In the middle stages raced keenly when positioned outside the lead.  Leaving the 200 Metres was momentarily crowded by COUNTRY PRIDE which shifted in slightly.  Approaching the winning post shifted in and made contact with LEADING DRAGON.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
THE PERFECT MATCH: Approaching the 1100 Metres was steadied when crowded by ELEGANT LIFE which shifted in and away from LEADING DRAGON despite the efforts of its rider E C W Wong.
CHAMP'S DOMAIN: Jumped only fairly and shortly afterwards was eased when LOOKING BRIGHT shifted out.
COUNTRY PRIDE: When questioned regarding the horse racing in a more forward position Z Purton stated that the intention was to hold a midfield position preferably with cover.  He said after jumping well when CASA BUDDY and DRAGON FOUR SEAS which were positioned to his inside were crowded for room he was able to allow COUNTRY PRIDE to stride forward.  He added when the pace of the event was run on standard time this resulted in COUNTRY PRIDE racing in an on-pace position, however, was obliged to race wide and without cover when not able to cross runners to his inside.  Trainer J Size confirmed the instructions.
CASA BUDDY: Shifted in on jumping and made contact with DRAGON FOUR SEAS.  Near the 1100 Metres became unbalanced when bumped on the hindquarters by DRAGON FOUR SEAS.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. H T Mo was severely reprimanded in relation to using his whip forward of the saddle in a forehand manner on one occasion near the 300 Metres.
BROWNNEEDSFURTHER: Near the 450 Metres was steadied when crowded by FREE PONY (M L Yeung) which shifted in when not sufficiently clear.  M L Yeung was reprimanded and advised he must ensure he leaves sufficient racing room for runners to his inside.  When questioned B Avdulla stated that he was given no specific instructions where to settle other than to ride his mount dependent on how it jumped.  He said BROWNNEEDSFURTHER jumped only fairly and after being bumped by LUCKY TWENTY this resulted in a number of runners drawn beside him showing more early pace.  He said in the early stages when positioned to the outside of EVERSTAR and GOLDEN BRILLIANT he was unable to cross those runners and therefore he elected to obtain a trailing position behind EVERSTAR to avoid covering additional ground.  He said when the pace of the event steadied in the middle stages BROWNNEEDSFURTHER commenced to race keenly and after improving into a tight run between EVERSTAR and FREE PONY near the 700 Metres raced tight between those two runners for some distance thereafter before having to be steadied near the 450 Metres.  He added that in the circumstances he was satisfied with the finishing effort of BROWNNEEDSFURTHER.  Sent for sampling post-race.
FRIENDS OF SHAJING: Held up from the 300 Metres until the 200 Metres.  When questioned regarding his riding C L Chau stated that his instructions were to go forward from a wide barrier and race in or behind the lead dependent on the pace of the event.  He said after jumping well he was able to ride forward to cross runners to his inside where he was positioned to the outside of LUCKY TWENTY.  He added that when positioned back off LUCKY TWENTY he made a decision to endeavour to find cover behind that runner in order to allow his mount to settle.  He said as he did so M F Poon, rider of LUCKY TWENTY, steadied the pace further and as a consequence DAN ATTACK improved quickly to his outside which resulted in FRIENDS OF SHAJING settling further back.  Trainer W K Mo confirmed the instructions were to go forward with the expected slow early pace.  After considering his explanation and the sectional times of the event which showed the early and middle stages were run outside of standard time, Jockey Chau was advised that he had made an error of judgement in electing to take a position with cover behind LUCKY TWENTY.  He was further advised in similar circumstances he would be expected to show better judgement than what he did on this occasion.
CHARMING BABE: Jumped only fairly.  Hung in in the Home Straight, resulting in its rider Apprentice H Y Yuen changing her whip through to her right hand leaving the 200 Metres and having to stop riding and straighten her mount on a number of occasions.  Sent for sampling post-race.
CORNERSTONE: Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with FREE PONY.  Near the 400 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by EVERSTAR which shifted in.
MEGA AWESOME: From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
EVERSTAR: In the early stages raced keenly.  For some distance near the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid DAN ATTACK.  Again near the 800 Metres became unbalanced when it got its head up whilst being steadied away from DAN ATTACK.  K Teetan reported that his mount raced keenly during the event due to the slow pace and refused to settle.  He said near the 450 Metres EVERSTAR, which was laying out, was then steadied to avoid BROWNNEEDSFURTHER when that runner was taken in by FREE PONY.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
LUCKY TWENTY: On jumping shifted out and made contact with BROWNNEEDSFURTHER.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
FREE PONY: Kicked a rail in the Parade Ring, was examined by the Veterinary Officer on arrival at the Start and passed suitable to race.  Bumped at the start.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
RUN RUN SUNRISE: Was a late withdrawal acting on veterinary advice after sustaining an injury to the left hip whilst being transported to the course.  Before being allowed to race again, RUN RUN SUNRISE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
VICTOR THE RAPID: Was withdrawn at the Start by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice after it was found to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, VICTOR THE RAPID will be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments.
SPEED DRAGON: On jumping made contact with SILVERY BREEZE due to both runners shifting ground.  Lay in over the final 200 Metres, resulting in its rider L Hewitson changing his whip through to his right hand near the 150 Metres.
MASSIVE SOVEREIGN: Between the 300 Metres and the 250 Metres was held up for clear running behind LE ZONDA.  When being shifted to the inside of LE ZONDA leaving the 250 Metres made contact with CALIFORNIATOTALITY.  Sent for sampling post-race.
TALENTS AMBITION: R Kingscote stated that his mount performs best on the All Weather surface.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have a respiratory condition which requires further assessment.
SILVERY BREEZE: On jumping made contact with SPEED DRAGON due to both runners shifting ground.  Due to the slow pace was steadied to avoid CALIFORNIATOTALITY near the 800 Metres.
GENTLEMEN LEGACY: Shortly after the start L Ferraris was required to reposition his left foot in his stirrup.  Due to the early and middle stages of the event being run outside of standard time commenced a forward move from the 900 Metres.  When unable to cross runners to its inside GENTLEMEN LEGACY was obliged to race wide and without cover thereafter.  Between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres raced tight between LE ZONDA and SPEED DRAGON which lay in.
LE ZONDA: Raced wide and without cover in the early stages and as a result was allowed to stride forward near the 800 Metres due to the early and middle stages of the event being run outside of standard time.  Near the 300 Metres became unbalanced when momentarily crowded between GENTLEMEN LEGACY and HELENE FEELING which shifted out slightly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
STUNNING PEACH: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CALIFORNIATOTALITY: Leaving the 250 Metres was crowded by MASSIVE SOVEREIGN (C L Chau) which shifted in.  C L Chau was advised to exercise more care.
OUTGATE: After travelling a short distance was crowded.
GAMEPLAYER ELITE: After travelling a short distance SPEEDY SMARTIE (K Teetan) shifted in when being ridden along, resulting in HAPPY UNITED, OUTGATE and A TIME FOR US being crowded in onto GAMEPLAYER ELITE which was steadied.  Whilst the Stewards accepted that Jockey Teetan had made an effort to straighten his mount he was advised in similar circumstances he would be expected to do so sooner than he did on this occasion.  H Bentley reported that his mount finished the race off satisfactorily and would derive a fitness benefit from tonight’s performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
GOLDEN ELITE: Shortly after the start shifted out and then was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
A TIME FOR US: After travelling a short distance was crowded.
CLASSIC TRIPLE: A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
PERFECT TRIUMPH: Approaching the finish could not be ridden out when held up behind LEGEND STAR.
HAPPY UNITED: After travelling a short distance was crowded.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
LEGEND STAR: After travelling a short distance was eased when crowded between FLASHING FIGHTER and BITS SUPERSTAR which shifted out slightly.
FORTUNATE SON: Bumped at the start.  Raced keenly in the early stages.
FIVEFORTWO: Jumped only fairly.  Bumped approaching the 500 Metres.  Near the 250 Metres improved between SAMARKAND and CHINA WIN.  Approaching the 200 Metres raced tight between SAMARKAND and CHINA WIN due to both runners shifting ground.  FIVEFORTWO was then held up for clear running between the 150 Metres and the 50 Metres when unable to improve to the inside of SERAPH GABRIEL.
LO RIDER: Approaching the 500 Metres was bumped by FIVEFORTWO which lay in and away from VIOLET STAR.
FALLON: Kicked a rail in the Parade Ring, was examined by the Veterinary Officer on arrival at the Start and passed suitable to race.  Shortly after the start made contact with FORTUNATE SON on a number of occasions.  Raced keenly in the early stages.
THE AUSPICIOUS: Jumped only fairly.  Near the 1300 Metres was eased when crowded by FORTUNATE SON which shifted in and away from FALLON when racing keenly.
GLITTERING LEGEND: L Ferraris stated that he was instructed to go forward.  He said when unable to cross runners to his inside GLITTERING LEGEND was disadvantaged by being obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
CHINA WIN: Shifted out on jumping and bumped FORTUNATE SON.  Sent for sampling post-race.
SAMARKAND: Near the 250 Metres was shifted to the outside of CORLEONE to obtain clear running.  A short distance later SAMARKAND made contact with FIVEFORTWO due to both runners shifting ground.
FOREVER FOLKS: Jumped only fairly.  The explanation provided by K C Leung for returning to scale 3 lbs over his declared weight was accepted.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
AURORA PATCH: When questioned E C W Wong reported that his instructions were to go forward from a wide barrier.  He said after being caught wide in the early stages to the outside of NORTHERN FIRE BALL he had anticipated that runner to go forward and cross FOUR STARS ALIGN in the Back Straight and for this reason he remained racing to the outside of NORTHERN FIRE BALL.  He said when NORTHERN FIRE BALL did not continue forward as he had expected this resulted in AURORA PATCH being obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
STRAIGHT TO GLORY: Near the 150 Metres was steadied and shifted to the outside of GOLDEN CHAMP to continue into clear running.
MY DAY MY WAY: After travelling a short distance was eased when racing tight to the inside of SYMBOL OF STRENGTH which shifted in.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
SYMBOL OF STRENGTH: B Avdulla reported that his mount lay in when placed under pressure over the final 200 Metres.
ACE CHAMPION: Jumped only fairly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
ALL OUT FOR SIX: Held up for clear running on the Home Turn and near the 350 Metres was steadied to avoid NORTHERN FIRE BALL.  Sent for sampling post-race.
FOUR STARS ALIGN: Near the 350 Metres was crowded by NORTHERN FIRE BALL.
ROBOT LUCKY STAR: Made contact with GOLDEN CHAMP on jumping due to both runners shifting ground.  As a result ROBOT LUCKY STAR shifted in shortly after and made contact with WUKONG JEWELLERY.  Near the 300 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by CALIFORNIA BLITZ which shifted out.  Z Purton reported that his mount raced too keenly during the race and as a result was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  Trainer M Newnham concurred with the views provided by Jockey Purton.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, ROBOT LUCKY STAR will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
NORTHERN FIRE BALL: Near the 350 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by AURORA PATCH (E C W Wong) which shifted in.  E C W Wong was severely reprimanded and advised he must ensure he provides other runners with sufficient racing room.
WUKONG JEWELLERY: Jumped only fairly and then was bumped shortly after the start.  Between the 250 Metres and the 150 Metres was held up for clear running behind NORTHERN FIRE BALL which was commencing to give ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. <15/10/2026 Additional Veterinary Reports>WUKONG JEWELLERY, which performed disappointingly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings. WUKONG JEWELLERY was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer J Size this morning. He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its right hind leg. Before being allowed to race again, WUKONG JEWELLERY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
GOLDEN CHAMP: Made contact with ROBOT LUCKY STAR on jumping due to both runners shifting ground.
